TechStores Equipment Register — Repair Intake

Repair intake · Stage 2 After gate booking, the storeman books equipment into this register. This is a custody / repair book only — it does not change the TechStores equipment inventory on charge. Item then proceeds to the IT Workshop. Each job requires ZNA SVCS 1045.

1. Gate (RP) → 2. TechStores Equipment Register → 3. IT Workshop Register → SVCS 1045

Tip: scroll sideways on the table if needed — Action stays pinned on the right.
